name: orchardcore-cli
description: Install local Orchard Core sites and manage tenants through Pomi.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, model, and manage Orchard Core tenants.
interface.longDescription: Skills for local CMS installation, authentication, content, media, templates, themes, settings, menus, GraphQL, and administration. Requires pomi; local installation needs the matching .NET SDK, while remote operations need an authorized tenant context.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the capabilities of my Orchard Core tenant.
Create and validate an unpublished article draft.
Help me diagnose a denied management command.
